decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel is core to the firm's strategy of trusted second-channel communication and binding mobile communication.
Mobile PDF signing supports the stated move toward online contract signing and sits close to the existing offer, so it costs little to maintain.
The multi-layer end-to-end architecture is a foundational framing of the integrated security offer and supports the other products.
Email-to-app message delivery is a niche feature, but it fits the secure communication direction and is cheap to keep as part of the platform.
The QR hardware token extends the established hardware options for transaction authorization, especially for banking customers under PSD2.
Payment security compliance matters to regulated customers and builds on existing expertise, which justifies keeping it.
